definitions.DIRECT_LINEAGE_VALIDATED: Direct-distance run has matching receipt/result and recorded motion/swept/wall PASS under its finite evaluated contract; not universal safety.
definitions.INSUFFICIENT_PROVENANCE: Cannot establish relevant model/backend and source from this metadata scope.
definitions.NOT_EXPOSED_THIS_DEFECT: Static moving-executor bypass or physical AABB local screen; ancillary spawn/goal/steering calls and unrelated defects are not exonerated.
definitions.OBSERVED_INVALID: Recorded swept proxy/wall violation in this cell; not a PhysX contact or proof every cell at this density is invalid.
definitions.TF32_EXPOSED_VALIDITY_UNVERIFIED: Historical cdist moving screen is eligible for matmul; exact runtime TF32/kernel and GPU motion validity unverified. Exposure is not a measured failure.

direct_runs.scope: Only recorded scenarios, seeds, gates and tolerances. No robot safety or universal collision-free guarantee; no retroactive validation of old cdist runs.

packet_diagnosis.scope: Historical packets omit full bars, original turn sign, batch identities/layouts and full candidate states; CPU reconstruction is not exact historical CUDA replay.

physical_snapshot_checks.scope: Exact archived source snapshot read; physical branch supplies bar_half_extents to bounded executor. This excludes the centre-distance local-screen cdist defect only.

reuse_policy: Keep historical performance tables, receipts, preregistrations and negative verdicts immutable.
Performance is conditional on the recorded simulator/source environment; do not reuse old GPU outcomes as proof of <=1.5m/s, bounded acceleration or collision-free target motion.
Old CPU mechanism PASS and zero reflection counters do not validate GPU point-distance arithmetic.
Do not pool old cdist and new direct lineages or substitute direct runs for replication of H/E1/E2.
No blanket invalidation of historical performance is inferred from exposure alone; observed violations and unverified exposure remain separate.

E0 bypasses the moving screen, but E0-minus-H contrasts inherit the exposed H reference. Receipt/result byte traceability is separate from moving-UAV motion validity and from cross-machine trajectory reproducibility.
Exposure class is orthogonal to original validity: VOID, withdrawn, failed and otherwise excluded records retain their original exclusion. NOT_EXPOSED_THIS_DEFECT is not a paper-reuse whitelist.

runtime_provenance_limits.direct_matmul_precision: Recorded in new run summaries; flags remain True/high. Raw tensor dtype still not separately attested where zero violation packets were written.
runtime_provenance_limits.historical_shapes: num_envs/active bars recorded in conditions; candidate axis source-derived; full strides/ordered tensors absent.
runtime_provenance_limits.historical_tensor_dtype: NOT_RECORDED per call; float32 is source/config inference, not a measured dtype.
runtime_provenance_limits.historical_three_and_seven_seed_tf32_fla: NOT_RECORDED per cell; current runner setting is not retroactive attestation.
runtime_provenance_limits.physical_scope: AABB local distance avoids this centre-screen cdist defect; other target spawn/goal cdist calls remain separate audit questions.

scope.hash_algorithm: SHA256 of sorted unique [repository_relative_path,file_SHA256] pairs encoded compact JSON
scope.recipe: Recursively select *receipt.json under source results, excluding source_bundle and receipts over 1500000 bytes; pair with sibling result.json or filename with .receipt.json replaced by .json; require parseable JSON. Hash every selected receipt/result and available sibling KROC summary. No logs, checkpoints, archives or episode rollouts loaded.
scope.unit: receipt-linked metadata record; includes canaries, repeats, tails and VOID families; not independent episodes or new measurements

shape_rule.cdist_default_mm_eligibility: point_count>25 OR bar_count>25; hence 73 candidates are MM-eligible even with <=25 bars, and all study densities 70/115/160/205 are eligible.
shape_rule.multiples_of_four: Only a kernel-selection pattern observed in one RTX3070/torch2.4.1 replay scan; never an exclusion rule.
shape_rule.zero_bars: No screen distance query; do not infer from large candidate count alone.
